name: Debt collection agency in Fatimid Fusṭāṭ
description: A Cairo Geniza legal document attests formal authorization of an agent for debt collection in Fusṭāṭ.

impact.note: One legal document witnessing an agent authorised to collect a debt; a convenience for its parties with no known successors.

date.label: 1050 CE
date.basis: Ackerman-Lieberman identifies ENA NS 50.32 as a Fusṭāṭ document dated 1050.

events.statement: A document from Fusṭāṭ records a formal appointment of an agent for debt collection.
events.scope: The citation provides a terse scholarly identification; the primary document and its exact terms, parties, sums and eventual outcome were not inspected. It is not an origin date for credit or agency.
